name: Crystal Healing
overview: Scripture warns believers against seeking guidance or healing through practices associated with familiar spirits, divination, or witchcraft, as these are abominations to God and defile His people (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:9-10). Instead, true healing and peace come from the Lord alone, who created all things and promises to bring health and reveal abundant truth to His people (John 1:3; Jeremiah 33:6). Believers are called to trust in God's benefits and reject any form of crystal healing or similar practices that rely on occult or spiritual powers contrary to His Word (Psalms 103:2).
